verdict.rationale: Docs describe 'smart invoice scanning technology' that can auto-populate recipient/payment details in place of manual entry (jeeves-docs-28), automated invoice payment/approval flows (jeeves-docs-27), and the MCP server lets an agent 'review bill pay invoices, manage vendors and their payment details' (jeeves-docs-47), which together support AI-assisted bill reading and review. However these are marketing-level descriptions without hands-on demos, screenshots, or independent verification of accuracy/quality of the AI extraction. Missing for 10: concrete demo or case study of OCR/AI reading a real bill, error-rate/accuracy evidence, and independent corroboration beyond first-party docs.
